context_for_next_testing_agent: WebRTC call functionality is implemented correctly. Backend APIs tested and working. Frontend call buttons appear with correct data-testids and are disabled for offline users (correct behavior). SSE events for call signaling are properly set up. To test the full call flow, need two browser sessions with different users online simultaneously. The call flow is: User A clicks call button -> REST API initiates call -> SSE sends incoming_call to User B -> User B accepts/rejects -> WebRTC peer connection established.

rca_of_the_issue.original_issue: Call/video call buttons not working on /workspace/chat page
investigation_findings: Backend call APIs (initiate, accept, reject, end, signal) all working correctly via REST
Frontend buttons are rendered correctly with proper data-testids
Call buttons are DISABLED when target user is offline - this is EXPECTED behavior
SSE connection is established and presence updates are received
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: NOT A BUG - The call buttons are intentionally disabled when the target user is offline. This prevents users from attempting to call someone who cannot receive the call.
rca_of_the_issue.expected_behavior: Call buttons should only be enabled when the selected user shows as 'Online' in the presence status. In the test environment, all test users (User 1-10) show as offline because they are not connected to SSE.
rca_of_the_issue.how_to_test_full_flow: 1. Open two browser windows, 2. Login as different users in each, 3. Both navigate to /workspace/chat, 4. Each user should appear in the other's 'Online Now' section, 5. Select the online user and call buttons should be enabled, 6. Click to initiate call
